subject: Quote for fitted wardrobes
body:
Hi,

I'm Thandi Nkosi. We're renovating our house in Bellville, Cape Town and need two fitted wardrobes in the main bedroom, floor to ceiling, white melamine with sliding doors. We'd like it done by end of November.

Call me on 082 555 0141 or email thandi.nkosi@example.com.

Thanks, Thandi

subject: Built-in bookshelf for study
body: Hi there. We are looking for a custom built-in oak bookshelf around a window in our study, roughly 3m wide. We live in Stellenbosch. No rush, maybe in the next 2-3 months. Contact: Annelie Botha, annelie@example.com.

body: Hey, wat sal 'n pergola met 'n houtdek kos? Ons woon in Paarl, ongeveer 6m x 4m, en wil dit voor Desember klaar hê. Jan Smit, 084 555 0177.

subject: Sash windows restoration
body:
Dear Sir/Madam,

We own a Victorian-style house in Observatory, Cape Town with six original timber sash windows that need restoring (rot at the sills, ropes broken). We'd like a quote and a visit in the next month or so.

Kind regards,
Rebecca Adams
rebecca.adams@example.com
